text: Settings Float 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的设置浮窗插件。它通过客户端模块增强设置对话框，将居中的模态窗口改为可移动、可缩放的固定面板，同时移除遮罩并让面板外的聊天区域继续接收点击。用户可拖动标题栏移动窗口，从八个边缘或角落调整尺寸，双击标题恢复默认位置，双击缩放把手恢复默认大小。窗口位置和尺寸会记在浏览器 localStorage，插件还提供启用开关、默认与最小尺寸以及点击外部关闭选项。适合希望一边查看聊天一边修改设置的 DSH 网页用户；不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

Settings Float makes the DSH web settings dialog a movable, resizable panel, leaving chat visible and clickable. Drag the header or resize from eight edges and corners. Double-click to reset position or size. Geometry persists in localStorage; options control dimensions and outside-click closing.
想调整 DSH 设置时继续看着聊天内容。
能不能把设置窗口拖到屏幕一边？
让设置面板可以从边缘和角落拉伸大小。
我希望设置弹窗别再遮住整个聊天页面。
想记住设置窗口上次的位置和尺寸。
点击浮窗外的聊天区域时自动关掉设置窗口。
Keep the conversation visible while I change settings.
I want to drag and resize the settings panel in my browser.
设置浮窗的拖动：拖动设置面板的标题区域即可移动窗口；位置会保存在浏览器中，下次打开时恢复。
设置浮窗的八向缩放：拖动面板任一边或角即可调整尺寸，并受最小尺寸和视口边界约束；尺寸会保存以便下次恢复。
设置浮窗的聊天透显：增强设置面板时隐藏遮罩并让覆盖层不拦截指针事件，使窗口外的聊天仍可见且可点击。
设置浮窗的配置：在插件配置中关闭增强、调整默认或最小宽高，或开启点击面板外关闭设置。
设置浮窗的尺寸和位置重置：双击标题区恢复默认位置，双击任一缩放把手恢复默认尺寸。

dsh-plugin-settings-float README · dsh-plugin-settings-float：DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns the settings dialog into a **draggable, edge-resizable floating window**, so you can keep the chat visible (and usable) while changing settings.

The native settings surface is a centered modal with a full-screen scrim: it covers the conversation and cannot be moved. This plugin keeps the same React tree but lifts the panel out of the modal — no scrim, a floating panel you can drag by its header and resize from any edge or corner.

dsh-plugin-settings-float README · dsh-plugin-settings-float：> ⚠️ This is a **DOM-level enhancement** built against the current DSH settings shell. The upstream bundle is never modified, and if a DSH upgrade changes the settings markup the plugin simply stops applying (the settings page keeps working as the native modal). Treat it as a convenience layer, not a fork.

dsh-plugin-settings-float README · Features：- **Draggable** — grab the nav title or content header and move the window anywhere.
- **Eight resize handles** — drag any edge (↑↓←→) or corner (⤡ ⤢); opposite edges stay anchored.
- **Chat stays alive** — the dark scrim is removed and the overlay stops swallowing pointer events, so the conversation is visible and clickable behind the window.
- **Remembers geometry** — position and size persist in `localStorage` per browser profile.
- **Reset shortcuts** — double-click a header to snap back to the default spot; double-click a resize handle to restore the default size.
- **Configurable** — defaults, minimum size, enable switch and optional click-outside-to-close are exposed as a DSH plugin config card.

dsh-plugin-settings-float README · Usage：| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| Drag nav title / content header | Move the window |
| Drag any edge or corner | Resize (min size applies, viewport-clamped) |
| Double-click a header | Reset position to the default spot (right side, vertically centered) |
| Double-click a resize handle | Reset size to the configured default |
| Esc / ✕ | Close settings (unchanged) |

dsh-plugin-settings-float README · Configuration：Open **Settings → Plugins → Settings Float** (the card is generated from the plugin schema), or set the row config in the profile patch:

```yaml
- id: settings-float
  name: dsh-plugin-settings-float
  config:
    enabled: true

dsh-plugin-settings-float README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | `false` keeps the native centered modal |
| `defaultWidth` / `defaultHeight` | `760` / `720` | Initial size, used until the user resizes once |
| `minWidth` / `minHeight` | `480` / `320` | Smallest size the window can be dragged to |
| `closeOnOutsideClick` | `false` | Sends `Escape` when the chat behind the window is clicked |

dsh-plugin-settings-float README · Compatibility：- Verified against DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` (desktop and web profile share the same settings shell).
- The panel is found by `role="dialog"` + settings-only children, with the release's hashed class only as a fast path — so a rename usually degrades gracefully instead of breaking.
- Requires a web-capable DSH surface (`dsh.client` platform `web`).

dsh-plugin-settings-float README · Privacy：- No network requests, no host-side changes, no telemetry.
- Only two `localStorage` keys are written: `dsh.settings-float.pos.v1` and `dsh.settings-float.size.v1`.

dsh-plugin-settings-float README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm test        # jsdom smoke tests: mount, 8-direction resize, drag, reset, config
```

Layout:

```
lib/index.js     host row: plugin entry + Config schema (the settings card)
lib/client.js    browser half: DOM enhancement, drag & resize
test/            jsdom smoke tests driving real pointer events
```

The client bundle uses DSH's client-module ABI (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`); `id` must match the package name.
